newsitem.title: ITALY: Autogrill sees margins up 3-4 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Autogrill sees margins up 3-4 pct in '96.

text.p: Italian roadside restaurant chain Autogrill said it expects annual sales to rise by 6-7 percent in 1996 compared with 1995, while it sees operating margins rising 3-4 percent from 1995 levels.
The group, which is controlled by the Benetton family holding company Edizione Holding, saw sales of 1.61 trillion lire in 1995 and operating profits of 74.8 billion lire.
The company made the forecasts at an analysts meeting where the group's chairman Gilberto Benetton and managing director Paolo Prota Giurleo were giving a presentation.
The group said the merger between Autogrill SpA, Finanziaria Autogrill and investment group Scheme 22 is still under study and a decision will probably be made in 1997.
Benetton said in the next three years the group hopes to expand its restaurant numbers to 210 from 60 currently.
